papers.title: Bacteria Death and Osteoblast Metabolic Activity Correlated to Hydrothermally Synthesised TiO₂ Surface Properties.
papers.abstract: Orthopaedic surgery comes with an inherent risk of bacterial infection, prolonged antibiotic therapy and revision surgery. Recent research has focused on nanostructured surfaces to improve the bactericidal and osseointegrational properties of implants. However, an understanding of the mechanical properties of bactericidal materials is lacking. In this work, the surface properties of hydrothermal TiO₂ nanostructured surfaces are investigated for their effect on bactericidal efficiency and cellular metabolic activity of human osteoblast cells. TiO₂ nanostructures, approximately 307 nm in height and 14 GPa stiffness, were the most effective structures against both gram-positive (Staphylococcus aureus) and gram-negative (Pseudomonas aeruginosa) bacteria. Statistical analysis significantly correlated structure height to the death of both bacteria strains. In addition, the surface contact angle and Young's modulus were correlated to osteoblast metabolic activity. Hydrophilic surfaces with a contact angle between 35 and 50° produced the highest cellular metabolic activity rates after 24 hours of incubation. The mechanical tests showed that nanostructures retain their mechanical stability and integrity over a long time-period, reaffirming the surfaces' applicability for implants. This work provides a thorough examination of the surface, mechanical and wettability properties of multifunctional hydrothermally synthesised nanostructured materials, capable of killing bacteria whilst improving osteoblast metabolic rates, leading to improved osseointegration and antibacterial properties of orthopaedic implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了水热合成TiO₂纳米结构的表面性能，涉及抗菌和成骨细胞活性，与AM生物医学材料方向间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure design for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no as-built morphology from additive manufacturing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiO₂纳米结构表面性能对杀菌效率和成骨细胞活性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过水热法合成TiO₂纳米结构，并表征其形貌、力学和润湿性。
summary_zh.result: 结构高度与细菌死亡相关，接触角和杨氏模量与成骨细胞代谢活性相关。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和细胞/细菌实验验证表面稳定性和生物功能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the surface properties of hydrothermally synthesized TiO₂ nanostructures for enhancing bactericidal and osseointegration properties of orthopaedic implants.
summary_en.method: TiO₂ nanostructures of varying heights were synthesized via hydrothermal method and characterized for morphology, stiffness, and wettability.
summary_en.result: Nanostructure height correlated with bacterial death, while contact angle and Young's modulus correlated with osteoblast metabolic activity.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing confirmed nanostructure stability, and in vitro assays validated bactericidal and osteoblast responses.

papers.title: Active Multi-Information Source Bayesian Quadrature
papers.abstract: Bayesian quadrature (BQ) is a sample-efficient probabilistic numerical method to solve integrals of expensive-to-evaluate black-box functions, yet so far,active BQ learning schemes focus merely on the integrand itself as information source, and do not allow for information transfer from cheaper, related functions. Here, we set the scene for active learning in BQ when multiple related information sources of variable cost (in input and source) are accessible. This setting arises for example when evaluating the integrand requires a complex simulation to be run that can be approximated by simulating at lower levels of sophistication and at lesser expense. We construct meaningful cost-sensitive multi-source acquisition rates as an extension to common utility functions from vanilla BQ (VBQ),and discuss pitfalls that arise from blindly generalizing. Furthermore, we show that the VBQ acquisition policy is a corner-case of all considered cost-sensitive acquisition schemes, which collapse onto one single de-generate policy in the case of one source and constant cost. In proof-of-concept experiments we scrutinize the behavior of our generalized acquisition functions. On an epidemiological model, we demonstrate that active multi-source BQ (AMS-BQ) allocates budget more efficiently than VBQ for learning the integral to a good accuracy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多信息源贝叶斯求积方法可迁移至生物力学仿真中的多保真度积分计算，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化在植入物设计中的具体应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on Bayesian quadrature for integral estimation, not on surrogate modeling for expensive simulation optimization, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵黑箱函数积分计算中多信息源利用效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出成本敏感的多源采集函数，扩展标准贝叶斯求积的效用函数
summary_zh.result: 在流行病学模型上，多源贝叶斯求积比标准方法更高效地分配预算
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成实验和流行病学模型案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To improve sample efficiency of Bayesian quadrature by leveraging multiple related information sources with varying costs.
summary_en.method: Construct cost-sensitive multi-source acquisition functions as extensions of standard Bayesian quadrature utilities.
summary_en.result: Active multi-source Bayesian quadrature allocates budget more efficiently than vanilla BQ on an epidemiological model.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic experiments and an epidemiological simulation case study.
